title: Lattice Mass Gaps and Continuum Criteria for Four-Dimensional Yang-Mills Theory
description: The complete two-column REVTeX manuscript incorporates the slow Gaussian heat-bath mode, slow marked-force response, an explicit operator counterexample and a corrected gap-transfer lemma at equal physical times. The weak-coupling Wilson bounds and nontrivial continuum construction remain open.
